title: Tax Payment Weekly Days Before Deadline Trend
dataSources: TurboTax returns (`turbotax:return`), IRS transcripts (`irs:transcript`), tax estimates (`tax:estimate`), tax payments (`tax:payment`), and W-2 imports (`w2:import`).
app: TurboTax return exports, IRS transcript pulls, tax estimate calculators, payment confirmations, and W-2 import logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tax:payment days_before_deadline=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(days_before_deadline) as avg_duration, max(days_before_deadline) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst days before deadline for tax payment events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture days_before_deadline on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average days before deadline with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It frames whether tax payment tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
